findings.summary: Net BB1_P has multiple global/hierarchical labels: BB1_N, BB1_P, BB2_N, BB2_P, BB3_N, BB3_P, BB4_N, BB4_P
findings.description: Net 'BB1_P' is labelled with multiple names: BB1_N, BB1_P, BB2_N, BB2_P, BB3_N, BB3_P, BB4_N, BB4_P. KiCad treats this as one electrical net, but a future refactor that renames one label without the other silently decouples the two halves.
findings.recommendation: Pick the canonical name and remove the other labels, OR document the alias intentionally (e.g. an expressly named test point). If this is a cross-sheet connection via both global and hierarchical labels, prefer one or the other style consistently.

report_context.impact: Maintainability — silent alias across future edits.

findings.summary: U5 pin CE (TX_EN) missing pull-up resistor
findings.description: Pin CE on U5 (ADF5901) is connected to net TX_EN but has no pull-up resistor. This pin type typically requires an external pull-up to a power rail for correct operation.
findings.recommendation: Add a 4.7k-10k pull-up resistor from TX_EN to the appropriate power rail.

fix_params.basis: Pin CE is open-drain/input type requiring pull-up

report_context.impact: Pin may float or bus may not function without pull-up

findings.summary: +5V has no declared source
findings.description: Net +5V carries power_in pins but has no power_out pin, no PWR_FLAG, no regulator output mapping, and no bridged solder jumper path to a sourced net.
findings.recommendation: Add a PWR_FLAG to declare the rail as externally powered (e.g. from a connector) or trace the rail back to a regulator output. If the source lives on another sheet, promote the net name to a global label.

report_context.impact: Rail has no source visible to the analyser; likely a wiring gap or missing PWR_FLAG.

findings.summary: Sourcing blocker: BOM has <50% MPN coverage (13/30 unique parts). Board is not pre-fab ready.
findings.description: Sourcing audit: 13 of 30 unique BOM lines (grouped by value + footprint) carry a manufacturer part number (43.3%). Pre-fab readiness requires 100% coverage; production assembly requires all parts sourceable via one of the supported distributors.
findings.recommendation: Populate the MPN field on the listed refs (use the digikey / mouser / lcsc / element14 skill to search by value/footprint when the MPN isn't already known).

report_context.impact: Pre-fab gate: board cannot be ordered until MPN coverage reaches 100%.

text_annotations.text:
POWER ENTRY + REGULATOR SET (Task 11)
+5V from interface header J1 pins 1/2; GND pins 3/4.
Input protection: D1 Schottky (reverse) + FB1 ferrite (per EV-RADAR-MMIC2 Fig.14).
U1 ADP7104-3.3 -> +3V3_TX (ADF5901).  U2 ADP7104-3.3 -> +3V3_RX (ADF5904 + ADF4159 analog).
U3 ADP150-1.8 -> +1V8_DIG (ADF4159 digital/SDVDD).
ADF4159 analog folded onto +3V3_RX per Task-11 amendment (drops ref board separate ADP150-3.0).

RESERVED FOR HIERARCHICAL SHEETS (Tasks 12-15)
[ PLL sheet ]  [ TX sheet ]  [ RX sheet ]  [ IO sheet ]
Rails (+5V/+3V3_TX/+3V3_RX/+1V8_DIG/GND) propagate as global power symbols;
signals cross via hierarchical pins added by those tasks.

ADF4159 PLL / FMCW RAMP GENERATOR (Task 12)
AVDD/VP -> +3V3_RX (per Task-11 amendment, folds ADF4159 analog onto Rx rail).
DVDD/SDVDD -> +1V8_DIG.  REFIN <- Y1 100 MHz TCXO (CWX113-100.0M) via R20 1k + C30 1nF AC-couple.
CP -> passive 3rd-order loop filter (R21/C33/R22/C34/R23/C35 = ref-design R19/C12/R18/C13/R20/C14,
ev-radar-mmic2.md Fig.12/BOM Table 2) -> VTUNE.  MUXOUT -> RAMP_SYNC.
RFinA <- RFIN_DIV (AC-coupled via C37, single-ended per datasheet note); RFinB decoupled 100pF (C36) to GND.
SPI_SDO is NOT driven from this sheet -- ADF4159 has no DOUT pin; SPI_SDO comes from ADF5904 (Task 14).

LEVEL SHIFTING (RESOLVED): ADF4159 CE/CLK/DATA/LE/MUXOUT are 1.8V-domain CMOS (abs max +2.4V,
adf4159.md Table 4). U7 (SN74AVC4T245PW, TSSOP-16) shifts 3.3V->1.8V: SPI_SCLK/SPI_SDATA/LE_4159/CE_RX
(A-port, VCCA=+3V3_RX) -> ADF4159 CLK/DATA/LE/CE (B-port, VCCB=+1V8_DIG); 1DIR/2DIR=+3V3_RX (A->B),
1OE/2OE=GND (enabled). U8 (SN74AVC2T245RSWR, UQFN-10) shifts 1.8V->3.3V: ADF4159 MUXOUT (B1) ->
RAMP_SYNC (A1); DIR1/DIR2=GND (B->A), OE=GND. Unused U8 ch2: B2 tied GND, A2 no-connect.
100nF decoupling per supply port (C47-C50). Ports: A=VCCA=3.3V, B=VCCB=1.8V (TI SCES576I/SCES692E).
SDO: ADF4159 MUXOUT owns RAMP_SYNC only; SPI_SDO readback is ADF5904 DOUT (rx sheet) per INTERFACE.md.

ADF5901 TX SHEET (Task 13) -- integrated into the Rev C root schematic
U5 ADF5901WCCPZ. TXOUT1(2)->C50 100pF DC-block->TX_ANT (to TX antenna feed).
TXOUT2(7) UNUSED per reference design: EV-RADAR-MMIC2 Fig.10 (top block schematic) and
Fig.13 (ADF5901 pin-level schematic) route TX_OUT1 and TX_OUT2 IDENTICALLY -- each to its
own SMA jack (J8/J9), with NO dummy load or termination resistor on either output. This
sheet replicates that exactly: TX2 gets the same DC-block treatment into an open/unused
local net, not a 50-ohm termination.
LOOUT(11)->C52 100pF->LO_OUT (to ADF5904 LO_IN). AUX(27)->C53 100pF->RFIN_DIV (to ADF4159
RFinA, which is normally ac-coupled from ADF5901 AUX per adf4159.md). AUXB(28) locally
decoupled to GND (100pF) -- not routed off-sheet, mirroring ADF4159's own RFinB
'~100pF to GND' treatment since only single-ended AUX drives the PLL feedback.
Decoupling triads (0.1uF+1nF+10pF) per rail from adf5901.md App-circuit values +
ev-radar-mmic2.md Fig.13 (TX_AHI; RF_AHI+AHI combined per Fig.13's shared AHI net;
VCO_AHI separate; DVDD separate). 4 distinct +3V3_TX stubs (TX_AHI[4,5]; RF_AHI+AHI[14,16];
VCO_AHI[30]; DVDD[17]) -- merged into one +3V3_TX net by the root sheet at Task 15; DVDD
triad C18-C20 added post-review. C1-pin=47nF, C2-pin=220nF,
VREG=220nF per datasheet Table 4 pin descriptions. RSET=5.1k to GND (R22 in ref design).
REFIN(15) connects to the PLL sheet's post-coupling 100 MHz TCXO reference through the
project-global REFIN net. ATEST(9), DOUT(24), MUXOUT(25) explicit no-connects -- not in
this sheet's interface (SPI_SDO/RAMP_SYNC are sourced elsewhere per the interface contract).

ADF5904 RX + BASEBAND (Task 14)
U6 = ADF5904, 4-channel 24 GHz Rx downconverter.
RF inputs RX1-4 and LO_IN are DC-biased on-chip; AC-couple per adf5904.md p.9. 100pF coupling value is an independent engineering choice (no discrete RX-side coupling cap shown in ev-radar-mmic2.md; Fig.23 there covers AVDD decoupling, not RF/LO coupling) pending eval-BOM/vendor confirmation (BOM-lock watch item).
Baseband RXn_O/RXn_OB (differential, 900ohm diff Z, +-20mV DC offset) -> light series-R/shunt-C per channel -> BBn_P/BBn_N hierarchical labels. Assumption: the 100R/100pF network presents ~2.2kOhm differential load to the baseband outputs, lighter than the 900Ohm datasheet reference load; datasheet does not specify a minimum load, so this is flagged as an assumption and expected to be benign.
Polarity convention: RXn_O (non-inverted, datasheet-listed first) -> BBn_P; RXn_OB (complementary) -> BBn_N. Applied identically on all 4 channels.
AVDD (pins 4/21/27, single 3.3V rail) decoupled with 0.1uF+1nF+10pF triads per pin, from +3V3_RX (per ev-radar-mmic2.md Fig.23 RX12_AHI/RX34_AHI/LO_AHI banks).
All GND pins (1,3,5,7,18,20,22,24,28,30) + EPAD(33) -> GND. ATEST(15) left unconnected (test/debug only, no-connect flag).
Standalone sheet: LO_OUT/RX1-4/SPI_*/LE_5904/CE_RX are hierarchical labels only; Task 15 wires this sheet's instance into the root schematic.
